title: Avenue Shorts Sewing Tutorial | Beginner Sewing Pattern
description:
This tutorial is meant to accompany the written instructions of the Avenue Shorts sewing pattern. Find the pattern here: https://sydgraham.com/products/avenue-shorts-sewing-pattern

Chapters:
(0:08) project overview
(2:44) prep: back pockets
(7:11) prep: side stripes
(19:21) steps 1-3, inseam pockets
(11:34) prep: split hem
(12:05) steps 4-6, side seam
(16:28) step 7, split hem
(17:54) step 8, baste pockets
(18:21) step 9, pre-fold hem
(19:48) step 10, rise
(21:56) step 11, inseam
(23:14) step 12, hem
(25:24) steps 13-18, ruffle hem
(31:11) steps 19-23, waistband
(36:25) final try-ons!

Correction: 23:20 If you're adding a ruffle hem, skip to Step 13. The video incorrectly says to skip to Step 19.

The Avenue Shorts feature a moderately high rise, an elastic waistband, and a subtle A-line silhouette for an easy, breezy fit. With customizable details like inseam pockets, side stripes, a split hem, back pockets, and a ruffle hem, you can mix and match to find your perfect “avenue”.
